request.text: Find me a new wireless gaming headset with a USB receiver and a flip-to-mute microphone for PC. What would it cost delivered to Byblos?

message:
The best lead is OutGeeked’s HyperX Cloud Stinger 3 Wireless: $101.99 in black, listed in stock. PC support and a wireless USB-A receiver are confirmed, and the shop states every item is brand-new and genuine.
However, its listing does not confirm flip-to-mute, so I cannot call it a fully verified match yet.
OutGeeked delivers nationwide, but shipping and taxes are calculated at checkout; the delivered cost to Byblos is therefore not confirmed.
Suggestion: verify the microphone’s flip-to-mute function before buying rather than compromise on your requirement.

product.title: HyperX Cloud Stinger Core Wireless Gaming Headset for PlayStation - White-Blue
product.description:
The HyperX Cloud Stinger Core Wireless Gaming Headset for PlayStation - White-Blue gives PS5 and PS4 players a simple 2.4 GHz wireless headset: plug in the USB adapter, and enjoy up to 17 hours of battery life, a range of up to 12 m in open field and 40 mm drivers in a closed-back, over-ear design.
Key features
2.4 GHz wireless connection through a USB adapter, made for PS5 and PS4
Up to 17 hours of battery life, about 3 hours to recharge over USB-C
Wireless range of up to 12 m in open field
40 mm dynamic drivers with neodymium magnets and 10 Hz to 21 kHz frequency response
Closed-back, over-ear design at approximately 240 g
Uni-directional noise-cancelling microphone with swivel-to-mute
On-board audio controls
Steel sliders with soft foam and fabric ear cushions
Who it is for and how it fits your setup
This headset is for PlayStation players who want to ditch the cable and keep things simple. The USB wireless adapter handles the connection, the on-board controls manage the audio, and the swivel-to-mute microphone is there when you need to talk to your squad. It is listed as compatible with PS5 and PS4.
If your gaming spot is a sofa a few metres from the console, the 12 m open-field range gives you room to move, and the USB-C charge cable makes top-ups simple.
Battery, range and sound
The headset runs for up to 17 hours per charge and takes approximately 3 hours to recharge over USB-C. Wireless range is up to 12 m in open field, which is plenty for playing from a sofa or desk

It suits gamers who switch between a PC, PS5, Nintendo Switch, Mac and phone and want one headset for all of them. Settings can be adjusted in HyperX NGENUITY software. Browse more HyperX products if you want matching gear.

Wireless USB Type-A dongle plus Bluetooth connection
50 mm drivers with 10 Hz to 50 kHz frequency response
Battery life of 80 hours or more, about 4 hours to charge
